title: Tiny, cute aeroplane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='sky' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#3a5fcd'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#5b8dee'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <g>
    <!-- tail fin -->
    <polygon points='62,42 72,30 72,48' fill='#ffd23f'/>
    <polygon points='62,42 72,30 66,44' fill='#ffe98a'/>
    <!-- horizontal stabilizer -->
    <polygon points='58,46 68,44 66,50' fill='#f4a300'/>
    <!-- fuselage body -->
    <ellipse cx='46' cy='50' rx='26' ry='10' fill='#e8453c'/>
    <ellipse cx='46' cy='46' rx='24' ry='6' fill='#ff6f61'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <circle cx='24' cy='50' r='9' fill='#ffd23f'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='47' r='3' fill='#fff3b0'/>
    <!-- cockpit window -->
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='45' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#9be7ff'/>
    <ellipse cx='29' cy='44' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#e6fbff'/>
    <!-- windows along body -->
    <circle cx='42' cy='49' r='2.2' fill='#9be7ff'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='49' r='2.2' fill='#9be7ff'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='49' r='2.2' fill='#9be7ff'/>
    <!-- upper wing -->
    <polygon points='38,44 50,24 58,26 52,44' fill='#f4a300'/>
    <polygon points='40,42 50,26 54,28 48,42' fill='#ffc94d'/>
    <!-- lower wing -->
    <polygon points='40,56 52,74 60,72 54,56' fill='#d97706'/>
    <polygon points='42,57 52,72 56,70 50,57' fill='#f4a300'/>
    <!-- tail stripe -->
    <rect x='64' y='46' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#9be7ff'/>
  </g>
</svg>
